title: Add commit_bead_state config toggle
description: Feature root for adding common.commit_bead_state to suppress noisy [bead] git commits. Touches config model, storage guard logic, CLI service wiring, onboarding scaffold and config template, and CLAUDE.md. No schema migrations or takt upgrade changes required.
acceptance_criteria: takt init produces .takt/config.yaml with commit_bead_state: false and .gitignore with .takt/beads/
Existing repos without commit_bead_state in config continue producing [bead] commits unchanged
Setting commit_bead_state: false immediately stops new [bead] commits on the next takt run
RepositoryStorage._auto_commit = False continues to suppress commits regardless of the new flag
RepositoryStorage.commit_bead_state is a public read-only property reflecting the constructor-resolved flag
uv run pytest tests/ -n auto -q passes on main
